version.changelog:
- Operates RiteKit through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI, without exposing raw credentials.
- Provides live schema inspection before running connector actions.
- Supports hashtag generation for text, URLs, and public image URLs.
- Adds relevant hashtags to social post copy automatically.
- Retrieves current hashtag stats, trending hashtags, and Instagram-banned hashtag cleanup results.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@46cfb3e`

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed RiteKit connector wrapper with limited command authority and no artifact-backed signs of hidden, destructive, or unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tool access is limited to Bash commands beginning with oo, which is proportionate for an OOMOL connector skill; credentials are described as injected server-side rather than exposed as raw tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill includes one-time oo CLI installation and login guidance, including remote install commands, but says not to run login or connection setup proactively and to use those steps only after matching failures.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The description uses broad provider-level routing language for any RiteKit request, but the runtime instructions remain service-scoped, require schema inspection before payload construction, and disclose user confirmation for any write or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background worker, broad local indexing, persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, or unrelated local data access is present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is operating RiteKit through the OOMOL oo connector, and the listed actions are RiteKit hashtag, trend, and suggestion operations that fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to use your OOMOL-connected RiteKit account for hashtag and trend-related actions. Be aware that setup may require installing and signing into the oo CLI, and any text, URL, or image URL payloads you provide for actions will be sent through OOMOL/RiteKit.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad RiteKit trigger is real but service-scoped; it may over-route general RiteKit questions, yet the artifact does not show hidden behavior, extra authority, or unsafe automatic execution.
